name: test_file_source_k8s
description: TEST SAMPLE (Strimzi / Kubernetes). FileStreamSourceConnector that streams a file inside the Connect pod into one Kafka topic. Deploy it with a Kafka Connect connection whose Deployment = Kubernetes (Strimzi on Docker Desktop or EKS); StreamBridge writes a KafkaConnector object and Strimzi reconciles it. The Strimzi Connect image must include FileStreamSourceConnector. See sandbox/kubernetes_stremzi and sandbox/eks.
